Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939)
I am not certain whether it was mentioned that sheets of the [Trial](/book/53) were to be sent to [Messrs Williams and Norgate](/organisation/165) to be forwarded to [M. Tauchnitz](/person/1396). He has just written to me to ask for them which makes me mention it.
I send the chapters of The Trial, all but the three last, which shall follow in a week or fortnight.
Yours faithfully
C. M. Yonge
